    How the scores work

    Priority = 2 × impact + urgency + frequency band. The band is 1 for 1–4 occurrences, 2 for 5–14, and 3 for 15 or more. A score of 10 or more is high priority, and 7–9 is medium.

    Repeatable tasks taking at least 60 minutes a week are flagged for an automation pilot. Estimated savings assume 50% of manual time is saved. These are planning estimates, not measured results.

    Rules run locally in your browser. No AI service or external database is used.
